judged_text: Scope drift plus regression: the 'simplification' of the org-slug spread inverts the IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED condition, so slug is now written when team billing is enabled instead of when it is disabled, in a file otherwise untouched by the destinationCalendar intent. Organizations created with IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED=false (self-hosted/default) no longer get slug set on the organization record, breaking org routing/provisioning for every newly created organization; organizations created with billing enabled now get a slug they previously did not. Nothing in this PR's stated intent (collective multi-host destinationCalendar) requires touching organization creation at all.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts`, the spread condition for writing `slug` into `organization.create` was changed from `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, which inverts the prior behavior. From the diff alone, this means `slug` is no longer persisted when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` is false, and is now persisted when it is true—an observable behavioral regression unrelated to the destinationCalendar changes.
